jobs.title: Market Fleet Manager - DACH
jobs.description: Why roadsurfer? TEAM SPIRIT & TEAM EVENTS: Look forward to a collegial atmosphere with flat hierarchies, lots of fun and great team spirit, as well as regular team events such as joint sports sessions, pizza & beer evenings, etc. PERSONAL DEVELOPMENT: We support your personal and professional development through an individual Growth Plan and our Inhouse Academy CAMPER BUDGET: You get an annual camper budget to experience the #happyroadsurfing lifestyle for yourself We look for a Market Fleet Manager for the region DACH ! As Market Fleet Manager – DACH you are a key member of the DACH Operations Leadership Team, reporting directly to the Business Director - DACH and working closely with the Regional Operations Managers . You’ll lead all Regional Fleet Managers across 5 DACH Regions, with indirect oversight of Fleet Managers, Technicians, Damage Detection Experts, and Spare Parts Experts for over 4000 vehicles at over 40 Stations. Your mission: drive fleet availability, repair turn-around, cost efficiency, and quality across the market — keeping our fleet running smoothly and our operations performing at their best. The role - your passion Own the Maintenance, Repair, and Fleet Transfer budget and ensure cost-efficient, high-quality repairs across the market such as Repair Strategy, Workshop Network, Spare Parts Inventory Define repair strategies per vehicle based on damage reports and operational priorities. Maintain strong vehicle availability by coordinating workshop capacity, scheduling, and spare parts flow. Build and optimize the internal and external workshop network to improve turnaround times and cost efficiency. Lead and develop fleet teams at the station (fleet managers, technicians, damage detection experts) ensuring consistent performance and technical capability, damage detection rates and spare parts inventory. Track key KPIs such as repair cost, time, and damage detection accuracy and spearheading strategic initiatives to drive continuous improvement.

jobs.description: adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment. Where 50 Billion Daily Predictions Begin The User Experience team is the origin point of adjoe Ads. Everything the system knows about a user, every prediction the ML models make, every bid placed in an auction. It all starts with code this team ships. The team owns two responsibilities. On the SDK side, a native Kotlin and Swift code runs inside hundreds of publisher apps. It participates in 120 million daily auctions , renders ad creatives across multiple formats, and captures the behavioral signals that power 50 billion predictions per day . The constraint that defines this work: you're executing inside someone else's app, on someone else's device, with zero tolerance for instability. Every ad impression has to feel native and fast to the user. On the analytics side, the dashboards, investigation tools, and data frameworks that turn raw data into decisions: real-time revenue performance across active campaigns, infrastructure cost visibility, and data quality assessments. If a number matters to the business or to engineering, this team makes it accessible. Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For: Auction & Marketplace Analytics: You will monitor core ad exchange KPIs—including bid rates, win rates, timeout rates, eCPM, and render rates—and run deep dives to uncover bidding patterns and supply path optimization (SPO) opportunities. We are looking for someone with 2–3 years of experience as a Data or Product Analyst in AdTech (Programmatic, Ad Exchange, SSP, or DSP) who understands what drives marketplace health and revenue. A

jobs.description: Who we are: Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products. Our culture: We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation. We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule. We're a remote-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to - work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport-optional, work-from-anywhere-on-Earth kind of remote - think flexible within your country, not borderless. Location: Remote MENA - Preference for Dubai Please note: This role will require up to 50% travel. About the role: Sales Engineering is a team of subject matter experts who serve as the trusted technical advisor to prospective customers. You will lead prospects through the sales process by connecting their needs to Sardine’s value to win new customers and drive revenue growth. You will deliver best in class product demonstrations, fill out RFPs, and win over our prospective customer’s technical teams with your thought leadership and consultative approach. jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity. We want you as a talented MAIT Additive Manufacturing Materials Intern to help us in our mission by contributing to Additive Manufacturing (AM) materials development, qualification, and in-house production for our vehicles Nyx Earth, Nyx Moon, and Storm. The ideal candidate will support the development and qualification of materials for additive manufacturing applications. This includes supporting material characterization campaigns, powder management, process parameter development, quality activities, and technical manufacturing documentation. Role Overview As a MAIT Additive Manufacturing Materials Intern , you will gain hands-on experience across the lifecycle of critical spaceflight hardware, from early development stages through qualification and production. You will support the development, characterization, qualification, and industrialization of materials for Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) technologies. You will contribute to material characterization campaigns, new alloy development, powder management, process parameter development, manufacturing documentation, and quality-related activities. Working as part of the LPBF Team and closely in collaboration with the AM Operations Team, as well as Propulsion and Quality teams, you will help us advance our additive manufacturing capabilities and support the delivery of flight-ready components across TEC's propulsion, launch vehicle, and space systems programs. Key Responsibilities Support material characterization campaigns with internal test laboratories, external testing partners and assist in the analysis and interpretation of powder, metallurgical, microstructural, and mechanical testing data. Support materials and process development activities, including alloy development, process parameter development, material characterization, and heat treatment optimization. jobs.title: Flight Software Engineer
jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity. At The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx - a modular, reusable orbital vehicle for space missions to stations and beyond. Nyx is engineered with the capability to transport cargo and, in the future, humans. We are seeking a highly motivated Flight Software Engineer to join our mission-driven team developing Nyx. In this role, you will take full ownership of key components of the flight software stack. You will be designing, implementing, and testing mission-critical systems that enable safe, autonomous, and reliable spaceflight operations. You will work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where cross-functional integration is essential. Your code will interface directly with vehicle avionics, guidance systems, propulsion, communications, and ground control. Expect to write modern, high-reliability C++ and Python code, drive software simulations, and ensure flight readiness through rigorous testing at both unit and system levels. The position level will be determined based on your experience, technical depth, and ability to take ownership. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and own core flight software modules for spacecraft control, telemetry, data handling, fault management, and communications. Develop in modern C++ and Python for support tooling, following best practices in software architecture, testing, and performance optimization. Build and maintain test frameworks for automated unit, integration, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing to validate software behavior across mission phases. Create and run high-fidelity simulations to model flight dynamics, subsystem interactions, and edge cases. Collaborate closely with GNC, avionics, propulsion, and mission operations teams to ensure seamless integration and mission success. Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and flight readiness assessments. What we would love to see from you Strong

jobs.description: Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. What you'll do This role is scoped by skill rather than by product. The problems below span multiple departments and show up across our Search and Places data work, our Location and Navigation Intelligence work, and the Platform work that makes Mapbox usable by agents. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands. At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area. In this role, you will: Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. Formulate hypotheses around the products we build and seek the signal needed to validate them. Define what a correct result is for a given input and state, determine whether to assemble datasets from real usage or hand-written cases, and gate changes on regression results. Run continuous evaluation of the products we build, whether APIs, SDKs, data representations, or reference applications, from the position of the end user, whether developer, agent, or consumer. Was wir jetzt brauchen, ist jemand, der die Schlüssel nimmt, Vollgas gibt und es mit jeder Runde besser macht. We're looking for an experienced SAP functional Consultant (m/f/d) to join our ERP Finance team at Flix, in Berlin or Munich. In the Foundation Division of FlixTech, the ERP Finance team is responsible for the platform that powers our financial backbone: accounting, controlling, procurement, period close, and the integrations that connect them to the rest of Flix. We're setting up a new ERP system for our Train business (FlixTrain) with a first focus on Finance and Procurement. As our in-house SAP expert, you'll work closely with our Finance and Procurement teams as well as external partners to make sure the new ERP fits our needs: today and in the long run. After go-live, you'll be the person who owns, evolves and continuously improves the SAP solution from the inside. This role is well suited for someone who enjoys ownership, working close to real business problems, and combining solid SAP craftsmanship with a long-term, in-house perspective About the Role Act as Flix's in-house SAP expert during the implementation of our new ERP, with a focus on Finance and Procurement. Translate business requirements from Finance, Procurement and adjacent functions into clean, scalable SAP solutions. Work closely with external implementation partners during design, build, testing and cut over. Support data migration, test management, and go-live preparation from a Flix-side ownership perspective. Take long-term ownership of the SAP solution after go-live: enhancements, change requests, integrations and continuous process improvement. Contribute to building broader SAP capability within the ERP Finance team thought teaching and mentoring. Be a trusted advisor to Finance and Procurement stakeholders on what SAP can do for About You 7+ years of experience as an SAP Consultant (incl. 5+ years in S/4H

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive - Berlin (x/f/m)
jobs.description: Großer Markt, perfektes Timing: Deine Verantwortung Berlin zählt zu den wichtigsten Gesundheitsregionen Deutschlands – und zu den Märkten, die Digitalisierung am dringendsten brauchen. Wir bei Doctolib machen diesen Wandel möglich: mit einer KI-gestützten All-in-One-Lösung, die Healthcare Professionals entlastet und Patient:innen bessere Versorgung bringt – Praxis für Praxis. Als Senior Account Executive (x/f/m) führst Du Dein Territory wie ein eigenes Business: von der strategischen Marktbearbeitung bis zum kontinuierlichen Umsatzwachstum. Deine Mission: Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams in Berlin und Umgebung für Doctolib zu begeistern, nachhaltiges Umsatzwachstum voranzutreiben und Deine Region zu einem der stärksten Märkte Deutschlands zu entwickeln. Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben.   Deine Aufgaben Territory Ownership vom ersten Tag an: Du trägst die vollständige Verantwortung für Dein Vertriebsgebiet – von der Marktanalyse über gezielte Akquise bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Du entscheidest, wie Du Deine Energie einsetzt, um maximalen Impact zu erzielen. Nachhaltiges Umsatz- und Pipelinewachstum: Du verantwortest Deinen Erfolg, Deine Pipeline und Dein Netzwerk in der Region – und Du weißt, wie Du alle drei systematisch aufbaust und konsequent entwickelst. Stärke im Neukundengeschäft: Du verstehst, was Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams bewegt – und machst dieses Verständnis zu Deinem stärksten Argument. Du akquirierst zielgerichtet, pitchst mit Überzeugung und bringst Deals konsequent zum Abschluss. Datengetriebene Vertriebssteuerung: Du misst Deine Performance konsequent mit Salesforce, analysierst Deine Kennzahlen, erkennst Muster früh und steuerst gezielt nach.   Dein Profil Wenn Du nicht jeden der folgenden Punkte erfüllst, aber überzeugt bist, dass diese Stelle zu Dir passt – bewirb Dich. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Perspektive! Nachgewiesene Stärke im Digital Health Sales: Du bringst solide Vertriebse

jobs.description: Set a new pulse for healthcare! We are looking for an Engineering Manager to join the Scheduling team in Berlin . Your mission will be to give practitioners their day back:  reclaiming the admin time they spend creating and managing appointments, so care teams can focus on what matters. You will work in a feature team developing scheduling infrastructure and booking experiences, contributing directly to a platform that books billions of appointments a year for health professionals and patients across Europe. Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. jobs.description: Standort: Frankfurt (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Wealth & Asset Management | Anstellungsart: Unbefristet Gestalte die Zukunft der Investment- und Beratungsservices im Private Banking im Rahmen einer bedeutenden globalen Transformation. Die Rolle Capco sucht einen Senior Business Analyst zur Unterstützung einer bedeutenden globalen Private-Banking-Transformation mit dem Ziel, die End-to-End-Landschaft für Investment & Advisory neu zu gestalten. Im Rahmen des Programms wird Aladdin Wealth als strategische globale Plattform für Advisory und Portfolio Construction eingeführt. Gleichzeitig wird die gesamte Investment-Wertschöpfungskette transformiert – von den Client- und Relationship-Manager-Journeys über Servicemodelle und Profiling bis hin zu Suitability, Portfolio Construction, Discretionary Portfolio Management, Execution, Reporting und Servicing. Du bringst fundierte fachliche Kenntnisse im Private Banking, Wealth Management und in Investment-Advisory-Prozessen mit und unterstützt dabei, komplexe geschäftliche, investmentbezogene und regulatorische Anforderungen in klare und umsetzbare Plattformanforderungen zu übersetzen. Dabei spielst Du eine wichtige Rolle bei der Harmonisierung von Advisory Journeys und Investment Services über verschiedene Regionen hinweg sowie bei der Vereinfachung und Ablösung ausgewählter Legacy-Plattformen. Deine Aufgaben Du gestaltest ganzheitliche Investment-Advisory-Journeys – von der Auswahl des Servicemodells über Client Profiling, Suitability und Portfolio Construction bis hin zu Investmentvorschlägen, Execution und Reporting. Du definierst Anforderungen für Suitability & Profiling , einschließlich Risiko, Knowledge & Experience, ESG, Eligibility und Investmentrestriktionen. Du entwickelst Anforderungen für Portfolio Construction und Advisory , einschließlich Asset Allocation, Investmentmodellen, Risikobetrachtungen und kundenspezifischen Restriktionen. jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer (DevTools & AI reliability, remote)
jobs.description: (Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 32-40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3) The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken. They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: end-to-end tests and synthetic monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place. Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel. Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. You will build reliability for this kind of software. Our stack is AI (Codex, Claude, use what you like best), Vue.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Golang, Postgres, ClickHouse and AWS. We ship to prod all day, every day. We practice Agile (not scrum) and take pride in good documentation and good looking products. We’re a remote-first startup that keeps things simple—low on meetings, high on productivity, and always shipping. If you love building cool things, working async, actually listening to and working with customers, and keeping it lean, you’ll fit right in! What you'll do Build and ship with AI You will actively use coding agents for full stack development, from exploring solutions and generating scaffolding to refactoring, test generation and debugging. jobs.description: TYTAN Technologies The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in. At TYTAN , we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty. We are looking for a Solutions Architect to own end-to-end solution design and technical leadership for TYTAN's C-UAS systems. This is a senior architecture role: you will design how our systems integrate into customer IT, C2, and service-management environments, and you will be the technical authority other architects and engineers look to on complex, multi-stakeholder programs. Your roadmap to make an impact Own end-to-end solution architecture for TYTAN's C-UAS systems and their integration into customer IT and C2 environments. Apply NAF v4 and/or ADMBw architecture frameworks to structure customer-facing and internal solution designs. Design and govern the full IT-service lifecycle, from requirements through deployment, operations, and decommissioning. Architect solutions spanning cloud, Kubernetes, and deployable/on-premise environments. Lead and mentor internal and external architects and technical teams across complex programs. Apply TOGAF, BPMN, and ITIL practices to structure architecture governance and IT service management processes. Represent TYTAN's technical architecture to customers, partners, and integrators. Defense-sector experience is mandatory; a former military background is strongly preferred. Practical, hands-on experience with Sparx Enterpris

jobs.title: Talent Partner - Manufacturing and Industrial
jobs.description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. You will work with privacy, legal, compliance, and technology stakeholders to understand business objectives and challenges, assess maturity and platform adoption, and provide clear recommendations across privacy processes, operating models, workflows, data, and integrations. You will act as a trusted advisor and product expert without owning hands-on implementation or configuration. Previous privacy or OneTrust expertise is valuable, but it is not the defining requirement for this role. We are looking for someone with the attitude, consultancy skills, and technical capability to learn the privacy domain quickly and become a trusted advisor. We re bringing on experienced engineers to help us create and maintain a 24x7, no downtime, global infrastructure system that powers the company’s three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and riders. We are building a single, shared platform designed to serve DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt, so your work will shape reliability and security for all three marketplaces. You will work on core components of our traffic stack, including our Cloudflare edge configuration (managed as code), and service-to-service authentication and authorization (workload identity, token issuance and validation at the mesh layer). This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, networking, and security. It includes designing, building, and maintaining systems that must operate reliably and efficiently across some of the most critical and latency-sensitive workloads at DoorDash, from the first byte at the edge to the last hop between services. You will report to the Engineering Manager of the EU-Traffic Team

jobs.title: Payroll Specialist
jobs.description: Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them. Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here . About the Role We're hiring a Payroll Specialist to join Sona's payroll bureau, taking hands-on ownership of UK payroll processing for a portfolio of our customers. Our bureau is growing fast. We're moving from around 15,000 payslips a month to roughly 22,000 by the start of Q4, driven by new customer go-lives in hospitality and care. That means the pace of the role is genuinely high, and we're hiring ahead of that curve rather than catching up after the fact. Day to day, you'll manage a portfolio of standard and mid-complexity clients across multiple pay frequencies: statutory payments, pension auto-enrolment, HMRC filings and payroll journal reconciliation. You'll also handle client queries through our support desk, working to fast turnaround times. Your work is checked by a Senior Payroll Specialist before it reaches clients, as part of our standard quality process. This isn't a conventional bureau role. jobs.title: Lead Tech SRE
jobs.description: About Kestra Kestra is the universal orchestration platform : open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems. Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide , including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole , Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars , hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community. About the role Kestra Cloud is our fully managed SaaS edition of Kestra. Each customer gets a dedicated Kestra instance on dedicated infrastructure, so the platform is a fleet of isolated stacks rather than one shared cluster. It is in Beta today, running production workloads for early customers, with General Availability planned for 2027. Each instance runs arbitrary user code (scripts, containers, queries against their own systems) through hundreds of plugins, and the fleet grows with every new customer. Provisioning, upgrading, and observing dozens to hundreds of identical stacks without drift is the core problem. We're looking for a Lead Tech SRE to own Kestra Cloud end to end: the architecture and specs, the delivery, the monitoring, and the continuous improvement of the platform. You decide how the platform should evolve, write it down, split it into work, and ship it with your team. You would lead a team of three, yourself included. That means you stay hands-on (a large share of your week is Terraform, Kubernetes manifests, and incident work) while setting the technical direction, reviewing designs, and dispatching work to two SREs. You work closely with the CTO, the platform engineering teams building the Kestra core, and our security engineer. This is an engineering leadership role, not a people-management-only one. jobs.description: LA MAISON Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai. VOTRE RÔLE En tant que Conseiller(ère) de vente, vous serez ambassadeur / ambassadrice de la Maison et vous jouerez un rôle essentiel afin d’offrir à chaque client une expérience unique dans le respect et l’engagement de la Maison Jacquemus. jobs.title: Erfahrener SAP Personalberater / Headhunter - Schwerpunkt Kandidatengewinnung
jobs.description: Die besten SAP-Spezialisten der Schweiz suchen keinen Job, sie wollen angesprochen werden. Für das «Who is Who» der Schweizer Wirtschaft finden, überzeugen und begleiten wir genau diese Menschen. VANGARD ist eine auf SAP spezialisierte Headhunting-Boutique mit dem Anspruch: Headhunting. Nicht Recruiting. Warum VANGARD, gerade jetzt Der Markt für Personaldienstleister ist unter Druck, viele Agenturen kämpfen. Wir stehen auf einem soliden Fundament: Seit 2012 sind wir im Schweizer SAP-Markt aktiv, haben bei über 400 SAP-Arbeitgebern platziert und sind in der SAP-Community bestens etabliert. Jährlich veröffentlichen wir das White Paper «SAP-Arbeitsmarkt Schweiz», mit Interviews von Branchenführern aus SAP-Beratung und Inhouse-Organisationen. Und dank unseres eigenen CRM-Systems vermessen und mappen wir den Schweizer SAP-Markt systematisch, wie kaum jemand sonst. Für dich heisst das: Du musst nicht jeden Monat bei null anfangen. Deine Rolle Du spürst Top-SAP-Spezialisten auf, für die sonst niemand einen Zugang findet. Du gewinnst ihr Vertrauen, verstehst ihre Ziele und begleitest sie bis zur Vertragsunterschrift und darüber hinaus. Unser Kandidatenpool mit tausenden Profilen, unsere gewachsenen Beziehungen und unser erprobtes Headhunting-Konzept geben dir vom ersten Tag an Rückenwind. Deine Aufgaben Kandidatengewinnung Systematisches Mapping des SAP-Markts: Wer arbeitet wo, in welchem Modul, mit welchem Erfahrungsprofil? Gezielte Direktansprache passiver SAP-Spezialisten über Telefon, Netzwerk, Empfehlungen und LinkedIn Aufspüren von Talenten, die auf keiner Jobbörse und oft nicht einmal auf LinkedIn sichtbar sind Kontinuierliche Pflege und Reaktivierung unseres Kandidatenpools Aufbau eines eigenen Netzwerks in der Schweizer SAP-Community, mit Empfehlungen als festem Bestandteil deiner Arbeit Qualifizierung und Präsentation Fundierte Interviews zur fachlichen und persönlichen Qualifizierung, von Modulwissen und Projekterfahrung bis zu Karrieremotivation und Wechselberei

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Index Intelligence
jobs.description: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. We crawl the web continuously and cannot keep all of it, refresh all of it, or spend a GPU on all of it. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked. We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves. Desired Experience You are comfortable owning a problem with no ground truth, where the first job is defining what the right answer means Hands-on ML experience with classifiers, rankers and calibration, plus strong data instincts at web scale You think in end-to-end impact. A signal only counts if a decision changes and search gets better You like working across teams. Crawling, indexing and retrieval all consume what you build You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world Example Projects Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it Tea

jobs.description: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. As a backend engineer, you'd play a critical role in our search architecture. We're pretty flexible on what projects people work on based on their skills and interests. Search quality is bounded by what we understand about a page. Before anything can be retrieved, something has to work out what the page actually says. That means parsing it into the parts that are content and the parts that are furniture, classifying what kind of page it is and what it is about, telling whether the page is usable at all, extracting when it was published, judging how good it is and whether it can be trusted, and working out whether it says anything that a page we already have does not. All of this has to work on every page on the web, in every language, in every shape the web comes in. Some of this is classic document understanding. Some of it is much more open. Credibility and misinformation, AI-generated and machine-spun content, and pages written to be found rather than read are all unsolved, and search results are only as trustworthy as our answers to them. We are looking for a research engineer to work on this. There is a lot of room to do it well. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll own the query engine that searches hundreds of billions of claims across a variety of retrieval backends, from a distributed graph database to vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial indexes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. No off-the-shelf system answers precise questions over hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims at agent speed, so you'll make foundational decisions, from storage layout and indexing across engines to the query language and the planner that routes work between them, that every query depends on. What you'll do Own storage and indexing across backends: data layout, partitioning and indexes for graph, vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval, with bulk snapshot builds and live ingest that never take the system down. jobs.description: Shift Supervisor | DSL-01 Voor DSL-01 in Delfzijl zoeken wij een ervaren Shift Supervisor die vanaf de voorbereidingsfase meebouwt aan de operatie. Iemand die meedenkt over procedures, voorbereiding van de commissioning en startup en helpt om operators klaar te stomen voor het moment waarop de installatie daadwerkelijk gaat draaien. DSL-01 wordt een grootschalige productiefaciliteit voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) en bijproducten. Over de functie Als Shift Supervisor speel je een sleutelrol in de veilige, stabiele en efficiënte operatie van DSL-01. In deze functie krijg je een unieke combinatie van projectwerk en operationele verantwoordelijkheid. Tijdens de huidige projectfase draag je in dagdienst actief bij aan de voorbereiding van de fabrieksoperatie, commissioning en startup. Zodra DSL-01 operationeel is, gepland vanaf voorjaar 2028, geef je (in ploegendienst) leiding aan een ploeg operators en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van een complexe chemische productie-installatie. Je zorgt ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en milieudoelstellingen worden behaald en neemt de leiding wanneer zich afwijkingen, storingen of noodsituaties voordoen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain en HSES. Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is dat je niet instapt in een bestaande organisatie, maar vanaf het begin meebouwt aan de operatie, productie en manier van werken. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Tijdens de project- en opstartfase (~1,5 jaar): Werk je in dagdienst Draag je bij aan de commissioning en inbedrijfstelling van DSL-01 Ontwikkel je procedures en werkinstructies Speel je een belangrijke rol in het uitvoeren van trainingsprogramma's en het trainen van operators Ondersteun je bij de opbouw van de operationele organisatie Zorg je voor een succesvolle voorbereiding op de start van de fabriek. In de operationele fase (vanaf medio 2028): Geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 8 operators

Integrate industrial cameras and frame grabbers through industry-standard interfaces and vendor SDKs, from driver set-up to stable high-rate acquisition. Integrate motion controllers and positioning stages through vendor APIs and controller scripting, including commissioning and tuning with the Mechatronics Engineer. Develop and extend FPGA-based timing and I/O for triggering and position-synchronized acquisition. Write driver and control layers in C/C++ and Python that the scan and reconstruction software builds on, and expose live status and data streams to the user interface. Own the instrument PC and lab network set-up: PCIe hardware, high-speed Ethernet links between devices, IP planning and device discovery. Bring up and debug hardware in the lab with oscilloscope, logic analyzer and network captures, and document interfaces and timing budgets with the System Engineer. Hier draait alles om experimenteren en het toepassen van opkomende technologieën om echte problemen aan te pakken. Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up. Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode. jobs.title: Meeloopstage Cash Control/ Finance
jobs.description: Wil jij ontdekken hoe de financiële motor achter een internationale logistiek dienstverlener draait? Ben je nauwkeurig, analytisch en krijg je energie van cijfers die kloppen? Dan is deze meeloopstage iets voor jou! Voor ons Cash Control team in Rotterdam zoeken we een stagiair(e) die meedraait in het dagelijkse cashmanagement. Je helpt bij het tijdig toewijzen van betalingen, het verwerken van bankafschriften en het bewaken van openstaande posten. Je werkt nauw samen met Credit Control, Invoicing en Accounts Payable en doet zo praktijkervaring op met cash application, reconciliaties en werken in ERP-systeem Exact. Waar ga je werken? Royal Den Hartogh Logistics is een internationale, toonaangevende logistiek dienstverlener voor de chemische, gas-, polymeer- en voedingsmiddelenindustrie. Ons familiebedrijf bestaat al sinds 1920 en heeft veiligheid en duurzaamheid stevig in het DNA verankerd. Met 54 locaties in 27 landen en ruim 2.600 collega's wereldwijd werken we continu aan slimme, toekomstbestendige logistieke oplossingen. Ons finance team in Nederland telt 20 collega's, verdeeld over onder andere Credit Control, Invoicing, Accounts Payable en Cash Control – en daar kom jij als stagiair(e) terecht. Wat ga je doen? Je bewaakt de dagelijkse Unallocated Cash : je houdt het overzicht bij, volgt openstaande posten op en rapporteert de belangrijkste KPI's. Je zoekt niet-herkende ontvangsten en niet-gematchte betalingen uit en helpt ze oplossen. Je boekt en verwerkt dagelijks bankafschriften in Exact, voor meerdere bankrekeningen en entiteiten (inkomend en uitgaand). Je matcht klantontvangsten en leveranciersbetalingen aan de juiste facturen. Je helpt bij bankreconciliaties en spoort verschillen op tussen bankafschriften en de administratie. Je denkt mee over verbeteringen om het toewijzen en afletteren efficiënter te maken. De ideale kandidaat Je volgt een mbo4- of hbo-opleiding in een financiële richting, zoals Finance & Control, Bedrijfsadministratie, Bedrijfseconomie

jobs.title: Go-To-Market Lead (Germany)
jobs.description: About us Hey there! We're Lleverage, and we're making the Autonomous Back Office actually achievable for businesses. We enable European companies to integrate AI agents into their business, because AI is only useful when it actually fits into daily operations. We help the most strategic European industries – manufacturing, logistics, and wholesale – automate the messy, manual processes that most tools can’t handle. We’re a fast-growing, VC-backed scale-up based in Amsterdam, with big ambitions for 2027 and beyond. This is your chance to join early, have real impact, and grow alongside the company. If that sounds something you want to help build, we'd love to have you on board! About the role We're looking for a Go-To-Market Lead to open and lead the German market for Lleverage. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role: you set the strategy for Germany, build the first pipeline yourself, close our first German customers and own the German number. You'll work directly with our founding team, including our CCO, and you'll be the face of Lleverage in Germany. As the market grows, you'll lead a small German pod. A Go-To-Market Associate will join you to run revops and German-language outreach and calling, and a Forward Deployed Engineer will join once the first deals are signed, to deliver for those customers. Dan is dit jouw kans om als Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau het verschil te maken! Dit wordt jouw baan Je vertaalt als Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau ontwerpen in optimale en slimme bouwmethodieken. Met jouw technische inzicht, praktische aanpak en overtuigingskracht speel je een sleutelrol in onze tenders en in de voorbereiding van onze projecten. Je werkt op het bedrijfsbureau van Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed in Rotterdam en maakt onderdeel uit van een ervaren team, met veel vrijheid en ruimte voor initiatief. Jij bent vanaf het begin betrokken bij onze woningbouw- en utiliteitsprojecten. Samen met een team van ervaren collega’s werk je onder andere aan: · Het analyseren van constructies en bepalen van de meest optimale bouwmethodiek. · Het opstellen van de bouwtijdplanning (Asta Powerproject) · Het opstellen van de algemene bouwplaatskosten · Het ontwerpen van 3D-bouwplaatsinrichtingen (Revit) · Het afstemmen met de materieeldienst, leveranciers en onderaannemers. · Input leveren voor BLVC- en logistieke plannen. · Input leveren voor een onderbouwd plan van aanpak om tenders te winnen. Jouw bijdrage is cruciaal voor het binnenhalen en goed voorbereiden van onze projecten. Je denkt actief mee over alternatieven en innovaties, met oog voor duurzaamheid en veranderende regelgeving. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. jobs.title: Data Scientist Marketing
jobs.description: At bunq, we’re on a mission to Make Life Easy for our users by creating the most user-centric banking experience out there. Our paid marketing campaigns run on predictions about which new users will turn out to be valuable. This role makes sure those predictions are right. That’s where you come in. As our Data Scientist, Marketing , you’ll own the machine learning models that predict the value of every newly verified user and feed that value into Google Ads, so our campaigns find more users like them. If the models are off, the spend is off. AI can help you write and debug code, but it can’t build the model or judge whether the output can be trusted. That judgment is yours. Take Ownership 🚀 You’ll own the predictive models that steer our marketing spend. Here’s how you’ll do it: Build, maintain and expand the predictive models for marketing, from first idea to production, starting with the models that predict each new user’s value in their first 90 days. Hit the model quality targets within 9 months: a Spearman rank correlation of 0.50 or higher and a binary model AUC of 0.75 or higher. Keep the models running in production and monitor data and model health to find where to intervene, using Claude Code to move faster and validating everything it produces. You’ve built predictive models with traditional machine learning, such as XGBoost. You’ve written Python and built the data pipelines a model needs, including when none existed. You’ve shipped ML models to production and kept them running. You’ve done deep dives into data and model health to find what needs intervention. You use AI tools like Claude Code in your daily work and know where they stop. You are fluent in English. Curious to see how we make life easy? - try the bunq app , it only takes 5 minutes to sign up. jobs.title: Stage of Afstuderen: Optimalisatie van Machine-inspecties
jobs.description: Wat ga je doen? Binnen Customer Service voert Voortman periodieke machine-inspecties uit om de technische staat van machines te beoordelen en klanten te adviseren over onderhoud, reparaties en mogelijke verbeteringen. Deze inspecties vormen een belangrijke basis voor het verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid, prestaties en levensduur van machines. Het huidige inspectieproces is door de jaren heen organisch gegroeid. Hierdoor worden inspectievragen niet altijd op dezelfde manier geïnterpreteerd, verschillen beoordelingen tussen monteurs en worden bevindingen niet overal uniform vastgelegd. Ook de rapportage richting klanten kan op onderdelen duidelijker, consistenter en meer actiegericht worden ingericht. Tijdens deze opdracht analyseer je het volledige machine-inspectieproces en ontwikkel je een vernieuwde werkwijze die aansluit bij de huidige en toekomstige behoeften van onze serviceorganisatie. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar de inhoud van inspectievragen, maar ook naar de manier waarop inspecteurs informatie verzamelen, beoordelingen uitvoeren, bevindingen vastleggen en resultaten communiceren naar klanten. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het analyseren van het huidige machine-inspectieproces en het identificeren van verbeterpunten; Het ontwikkelen van een logische en uniforme structuur voor machine-inspecties; Het herformuleren en standaardiseren van bestaande inspectievragen; Het opstellen van duidelijke beoordelingscriteria voor de technische staat van machineonderdelen; Het ontwikkelen van een uniforme methode voor het vastleggen van metingen, bevindingen, foto's en aanbevolen acties; Het verbeteren van inspectierapportages zodat technische bevindingen overzichtelijk, eenduidig en actiegericht worden gepresenteerd; Het opstellen van een implementatievoorstel voor het vernieuwde inspectieproces binnen Customer Service. Het eindresultaat is een praktisch en onderbouwd verbeterplan waarmee Voortman machine-inspecties wereldwijd op een uniforme manier kan uitvoere

jobs.description: Wat ga je doen? Binnen Service & Support onderzoeken we hoe Augmented Reality (AR) kan bijdragen aan een efficiëntere en effectievere dienstverlening. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
jobs.description: Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers. Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading. About This Role: We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across UK, Germany, and Spain. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio. We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding. Our Benefits: At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect: A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities. A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas. 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge. A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life. Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role. Mental health coaching to support you

Alles Made in Germany - unsere Gusseisenpfannen sind preisgekrönt. Wir möchten Foodies wie dich zu neuen kulinarischen Entdeckungen inspirieren und die Profiküche zu dir nach Hause bringen. Wir haben ein funktionierendes, profitables Geschäftsmodell, wachsen dynamisch und wollen bis 2030 in einer Million Küchen zu finden sein. Um das zu erreichen, denken wir Performance Marketing und Branding aus einem Guss. Und hierfür suchen wir nun dich als Head of Marketing & Growth (w/m/d). (deutschsprachig, ab sofort, hybrid in Berlin oder remote). Deine Aufgaben Verantwortung für Umsatz und Marketingeffizienz : Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unser zukünftiges Wachstum und die weitere Profitabilität unserer Marke. Strategie : Zusammen mit unseren Co-Foundern entwickelst du die Marketingstrategie weiter und arbeitest an der kontinuierlichen Umsetzung. Du entwickelst und etablierst Prozesse und Strukturen, die weiteres Wachstum ermöglichen. Leadership : Du leitest ein dreiköpfiges Team und baust es langfristig weiter aus. Dabei führst du auf Augenhöhe und förderst die individuelle Entwicklung deiner Teammitglieder. Hands-on-Umsetzung : Zusammen mit deinem Team sowie Agenturen und Freelancer*innen setzt du die Strategie in Kampagnen um (aktuell v.a. Meta Ads, Google Ads, CRM und Influencer). Dein Profil Du besitzt mehrjährige fundierte Berufserfahrung im Onlinemarketing in stark wachsenden E-Commerce-Unternehmen und hast ausgeprägte Erfahrung in der Full-Funnel-Steuerung.

jobs.title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description: Senior DevSecOps Engineer Location : London | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent Build the platforms that power secure, intelligent and scalable enterprise engineering. The Role At Capco, we re looking for a Senior DevSecOps Engineer to help design, build and modernise enterprise software delivery capabilities for leading financial services organisations. You ll play a key role in developing a modern enterprise Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) platform, with a focus on CI/CD automation, policy-as-code, security controls and cloud-native engineering. This is a hands-on engineering opportunity where you ll translate architecture into production-ready capabilities, integrate complex enterprise technologies and support engineering teams in adopting scalable, secure delivery practices. You ll also explore approved AI-enabled engineering tools and workflows to improve development productivity, automation and delivery quality, while maintaining appropriate human oversight, security controls and responsible AI practices. What You’ll Do Build modern CI/CD platforms: Design, develop and implement enterprise GitLab SaaS CI/CD pipelines, reusable engineering patterns and automated workflows, leveraging approved AI-assisted engineering capabilities where appropriate to improve efficiency and quality. Embed security and governance: Implement policy-as-code, automated security and quality gates, change controls, SAST, DAST, secrets management and vulnerability management throughout the SDLC. Engineer cloud-native solutions: Build and integrate services across Azure, Kubernetes and Azure API Management, supporting application, cloud and data workloads, including Snowflake and Salesforce. jobs.title: 3D Computer Vision Research Engineer, Geospatial Visual Localization
jobs.description: About Niantic Spatial AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time. That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are. In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right. Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us. About the Role We are looking for a Research Engineer to help develop our Geospatial Visual Localization technologies, which allows people and robots to accurately localize themselves anywhere on the planet. This is an end-to-end applied research role. You will develop new approaches to open problems alongside our researchers in 3D vision and machine learning, and publish your work at leading conferences. You will help build and train large models on large-scale multi-modal datasets, including our proprietary collection of 30 billion posed images and ship them into production, to be used by people and robots from all over the world. jobs.description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. jobs.title: Applied AI Delivery Lead - London
jobs.description: About the Role OpenAI’s largest and most strategic customers are turning AI ambition into deployments that change how their organizations work. As a Delivery Lead, you will own delivery of priority AI initiatives for these customers, leading complex, high-impact deployments from planning through launch and adoption. You’ll establish an integrated delivery plan, drive execution against launch commitments, resolve blockers, and lead progress toward measurable customer value. You’ll partner closely with account and technical teams, FDEs, customers, and delivery partners to turn customer priorities into successful deployments. You’ll bring a clear view of delivery progress, risks, and expected outcomes, helping teams make informed decisions and connecting successful execution to consumption and growth. This is a senior, customer-facing role for someone who can move between executive conversations and practical details that determine whether a deployment succeeds. You bring technical fluency, sound judgment, and the ability to create clarity and drive action in complex, evolving environments. What You’ll Do Own delivery of priority AI initiatives. Lead complex customer engagements from scoping and planning through deployment, launch, and initial adoption. Build and drive an integrated delivery plan. Establish clear scope, milestones, accountable owners, dependencies, resource needs, and success measures across customer, OpenAI, and partner teams. Resolve blockers and drive decisions. Identify risks early, work through dependencies and resource constraints, and bring the right stakeholders together to resolve tradeoffs and keep delivery moving. Lead launch readiness and activation. Drive rollout and enablement planning, address technical and organizational readiness gaps, and remove barriers to initial adoption and usage. Connect delivery to customer value. Define expected outcomes and measurement approaches with customers and account teams. Track adoption and consumption

jobs.title: Enterprise Product Manager
jobs.description: Enterprise Product Manager The Role Lyrebird is already trusted by thousands of clinicians, and the largest health organisations in Australia and the UK are now rolling it out across their entire workforce. This is a new role, created to lead the next chapter of our enterprise product as those deployments grow in size and ambition. You'll own the enterprise product end to end: the core platform capability that serves every enterprise customer, and the tailored work that deepens our partnership with specific ones. You'll have a real roadmap, a real engineering team, and the scope to shape where enterprise goes next. A good week in this role might include a roadmap session with a state health service's IT team, a deep dive with a private hospital group to understand what's behind their latest request and how it could become something every enterprise customer benefits from, and a morning with engineering working out which of three competing priorities goes first. Your customers are the people deploying Lyrebird across their organisation, not the clinicians themselves, so you'll spend more time in customer conversations than most PMs do. If you enjoy that mix, and like being the person who makes the call when everything seems urgent, you'll do well here. About Us We turn real clinical conversations into accurate notes, automatically, backed by ambient real time document creation, intelligent document management and clinical workflow automation, native patient data integrations across siloed health systems, and a patient and clinical communications layer. Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. We're growing fast across Melbourne, the UK, and Asia, and there's a finite window right now to set the standard for clinical AI in Australia before anyone else does. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Software Engineer The Role We’re hiring a Software Engineer to maintain and grow the platform that clinicians rely on every day. You’ll work across the whole stack and in both of our main repositories: the SvelteKit front end and the Python services that power document generation with large language models. You’ll take features from idea to production, keep the platform fast, reliable and cost-effective, and work closely with our Product Engineer and engineering leadership to turn the roadmap into shippable work. You’ll also help set the engineering standard for the team through thoughtful code review and sound technical judgement. This role suits a broad, highly capable engineer who enjoys owning problems end to end rather than staying in one layer. You’ll be comfortable moving from a Svelte component to a FastAPI service to a database migration in a single afternoon, and you’ll enjoy the detective work of tracing a slow request or getting to the root cause of a production incident. You’ll lead in some areas and learn from teammates in others, and you’ll care as much about quality, safety and maintainability as you do about shipping. About Us Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians’ most time-consuming tasks. Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. Everything we build is grounded in earning trust, reducing cognitive load, and delivering meaningful impact at scale. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we're changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. jobs.description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. The Senior AI Engineer will join Kpler's new AI Enablement crew, whose mission is to give every function in the company the tools, frameworks, and AI agents to work with AI at scale. You bring engineering rigour to a fast-moving space: the systems you ship must be reliable, observable, safe, and worth their cost. You will also help raise the bar for AI-assisted engineering across Kpler and mentor less experienced engineers in the crew. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and operate AI systems for internal functions — agents, assistants, and automations — owning them end-to-end from design through production operation.
